currency.basis: Official seb.lv notice announces the light-to-dark-green colour change of the unchanged SEB app icon; App Store shows the dark-green icon with currentVersionReleaseDate 2026-10-01. The accepted baseline light green (#60cd18) is the pre-change colour.

identity.basis: The white SEB lettermark with vertical separators is served by seb.lv itself as its favicon/logo asset; letter geometry matches the accepted baseline lettering and the current app icon.

assessment.independenceRationale: One official written announcement (seb.lv notice), the bank's own served SVG assets, and the store listing of the bank's app under its control; the store entry is a separate distribution channel, not a copy of the notice page.

variant.basis: Current variant: white SEB letters on dark green (~#013823). The country-flag corner belongs to the Latvia app icon presentation; the standalone SEB mark is the lettering on the green field, used here without the flag.

candidate.detailsJudgement: All separators and letter counters preserved; no clipped strokes at circle edge; small-size legibility fine - the lettermark is bold and high-contrast on the dark green field.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Letter block centred in the circle, comparable scale to the accepted baseline; whole emblem fits within the circular field with margin at top and bottom of the letters.
candidate.rationale: Documented rebrand: official SEB LV notice (seb.lv, 2026) changed the app icon colour from light green to dark green with unchanged design, and the App Store shows the dark-green icon (currentVersionReleaseDate 2026-10-01). The accepted baseline is the pre-change light green (#60cd18), so an update is justified.
candidate.role: Standalone SEB lettermark (white SEB letters with vertical separators) on a dark-green plain-field circular backing; catalog presentation of the bank mark without the country-flag corner used in the Latvia app icon.
transforms: Embedded the original letter paths from the official favicon_dark.svg unchanged inside a scaled group: translate(0,-0.25) scale(1.6875) into a 54x54 viewBox; no geometry or colour change to the emblem.

Added a background-only plain field: circle cx=27 cy=27 r=27 fill=#013823 behind the letters (plain-field circle policy; #013823 sampled from the official App Store icon per the colour-change notice).

candidate.variant: Current dark-green variant per the official colour-change notice; letterforms taken unchanged from the official seb.lv favicon_dark.svg.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Field colour changes from light green #60cd18 to dark green #013823; letterforms and circular presentation are visually equivalent to the baseline.

proposals.reason: Documented rebrand: official SEB LV notice states the app icon colour changed from light green to dark green with unchanged design; the accepted baseline is the light-green (#60cd18) circle, so it is not the current variant.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Official original-vector lettermark of the current SEB brand (white letters with separators), downloaded directly from seb.lv (sha256 3d027002a833d12c275426c3624e726845748edd7236c13d3f4a38a2369f447f, saved as evidence/15440/candidate-source.svg); used as-is with only a background-field adaptation to the officially announced dark green. Documented update: official notice + 2026-10-01 store icon replace the light-green (#60cd18) baseline.

sources.observation: Official SEB Latvia notice 'Drizumā mainīsies SEB Mobilās lietotnes ikona': the app icon design stays the same (SEB logo with the Latvian flag in the upper right corner) and only its colour changes - from light green to dark green, rolled out over about two weeks.

Current seb.lv theme serves favicon_dark.svg directly (32x32, SEB letters with vertical separators, viewBox 0 0 32 32, letters within clip 28x12.29 at translate(2,10)); referenced from the page https://www.seb.lv/ with rel=icon. The favicon_dark letters render white on transparent; seb-logo.svg is the black-letters header variant.

sources.independenceGroup: Apple App Store listing of the bank's own app
sources.observation: App Store listing 'SEB Latvia' (bundle se.seb.seblatvia, seller Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken AB, currentVersionReleaseDate 2026-10-01): icon is a dark green field (~#013823) with white SEB letters and the Latvian flag corner, matching the official colour-change notice.
